45: 	// TODO: honor context cancellation... unfortunately go-plugin doesn't seem
46: 	// to give us a mechanism for this, so we'd have to spin up some goroutine
47: 	// to watch for cancellation and start killing clients and closing
48: 	// connections and the like.
49: 
50: 	// Resolve path to an absolute path. We don't want to rely on PATH
51: 	// environment lookups for security reasons.
52: 	path, err := filepath.Abs(config.Path)
53: 	if err != nil {
54: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve plugin path: %w", err)
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	cmd := pluginCmd(path, config.Args...)
58: 
59: 	var secureConfig *goplugin.SecureConfig
60: 	if config.Checksum != "" {
61: 		secureConfig, err = buildSecureConfig(config.Checksum)
62: 		if err != nil {
63: 			return nil, err
64: 		}
65: 	} else {
66: 		config.Log.Warn("Plugin checksum not configured")
67: 	}
68: 
69: 	logger := log.NewHCLogAdapter(
70: 		config.Log,
71: 		config.Name,
72: 	)

74: 	// Start the external plugin.
75: 	pluginClient := goplugin.NewClient(&goplugin.ClientConfig{
76: 		HandshakeConfig: goplugin.HandshakeConfig{
77: 			ProtocolVersion:  1,
78: 			MagicCookieKey:   config.Type,
79: 			MagicCookieValue: config.Type,
80: 		},
81: 		Cmd: cmd,
82: 		// TODO: Enable AutoMTLS if it is fixed to work with brokering.
83: 		// See https://github.com/hashicorp/go-plugin/issues/109
84: 		AutoMTLS:         false,
85: 		AllowedProtocols: []goplugin.Protocol{goplugin.ProtocolGRPC},
86: 		Plugins: map[string]goplugin.Plugin{
87: 			config.Name: &hcClientPlugin{config: config},
88: 		},
89: 		Logger:       logger,
90: 		SecureConfig: secureConfig,
91: 	})

93: 	// Ensure the loaded plugin is killed if there is a failure.
94: 	defer func() {
95: 		if err != nil {
96: 			pluginClient.Kill()
97: 		}
98: 	}()

100: 	// Create the GRPC client and ensure it is closed on error.
101: 	grpcClient, err := pluginClient.Client()
102: 	if err != nil {
103: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to launch plugin: %w", err)

105: 	defer func() {

107: 			grpcClient.Close()

+	const prefix = "Unrecognized remote plugin message: "
